<distribution id="YuleModel.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.speciation.YuleModel" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"> <birthDiffRate id="speciationRate.t:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="speciationRatePrior.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@speciationRate.t:$(n)"> <lower id="speciationRatePriorLower.t:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="speciationRatePriorUpper.t:$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<operator id="SubtreeSlide.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.kernel.BactrianSubtreeSlide" weight="15.0" size="0.002" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="WilsonBalding.t:$(n)" spec="WilsonBalding" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="Wide.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="false" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="Narrow.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="true" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="UniformOperator.t:$(n)" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Uniform"/> <operator id="TreeRootScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.7" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rootOnly="true" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/> <operator id="TreeScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.95" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/>
<operator id="speciationRateScale.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="1.0" parameter="@speciationRate.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
Yule speciation prior applied to the species tree
Prior on birth (a.k.a. speciation) rate applied to the species tree
Scale the birth (a.k.a. speciation) rate of the species tree

<distribution id="CalibratedYuleModel.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.speciation.CalibratedYuleModel" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"> <birthRate id="cySpeciationRate.t:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="cySpeciationRatePrior.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@cySpeciationRate.t:$(n)"> <lower id="cySpeciationRatePriorLower.t:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="cySpeciationRatePriorUpper.t:$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<operator id="cySubtreeSlide.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.kernel.BactrianSubtreeSlide" weight="15.0" size="0.002" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="cyWilsonBalding.t:$(n)" spec="WilsonBalding" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="cyWide.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="false" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="cyNarrow.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="true" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="cyUniformOperator.t:$(n)" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Uniform"/> <operator id="cyTreeRootScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.7" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rootOnly="true" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/> <operator id="cyTreeScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.95" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/>

Calibrated Yule speciation prior applied to the species tree
Prior on birth (a.k.a. speciation) rate applied to a calibrated species tree

<distribution id="BirthDeathModel.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.speciation.BirthDeathGernhard08Model" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"> <birthDiffRate id="netDiversificationRate.t:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <relativeDeathRate id="ExtinctionFraction.t:$(n)" value="0.5" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="netDiversificationRatePrior.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@netDiversificationRate.t:$(n)"> <lower id="netDiversificationRatePriorLower.t:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="netDiversificationRatePriorUpper.t:$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution> <distribution id="ExtinctionFractionPrior.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@ExtinctionFraction.t:$(n)"> <lower id="ExtinctionFractionPriorLower.t:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="ExtinctionFractionPriorUpper.t:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<operator id="bdSubtreeSlide.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.kernel.BactrianSubtreeSlide" weight="15.0" size="0.002" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="bdWilsonBalding.t:$(n)" spec="WilsonBalding" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="bdWide.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="false" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="bdNarrow.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="true" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="bdUniformOperator.t:$(n)" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Uniform"/> <operator id="bdTreeRootScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.7" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rootOnly="true" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/> <operator id="bdTreeScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.95" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/>
<operator id="netDiversificationRateScale.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="1.0" parameter="@netDiversificationRate.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="ExtinctionFractionScale.t:$(n)" parameter="@ExtinctionFraction.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="0.5" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="ExtinctionFractionUniform.t:$(n)" parameter="@ExtinctionFraction.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.uniform.IntervalOperator" weight="0.5"/>
